"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Ending the forever wars, reducing the enormous stress on forces, and rationalizing the global military footprint are essential prerequisites to securing a competitive edge.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will invest in technology and forces that meet the threats of the future—from cyber to space, and artificial intelligence to unmanned systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reinforce alliances and partnerships that enhance collective security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support funding a more cost-effective, agile, flexible, and resilient force with modern transportation and logistics capabilities that can operate in more contested environments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will accelerate defense transformation in a responsible, ethical way, and with strong privacy protections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The implications of climate change for national security and the Department of Defense can no longer be an afterthought, but must be at the core of all policy and operational plans to secure vital interests.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
